profile.name: 带ROI统计功能的面阵探测器
profile.description: 用于实验成像的面阵探测器系统，可采集二维图像并对感兴趣区域（ROI）进行强度或计数统计。常用于同步辐射束线、X射线成像和通用扫描实验中的在线监测、快门联动与文件存储。
profile.description_en: A 2D area detector system for experimental imaging that acquires images and computes intensity or count statistics in selected regions of interest (ROIs). It is commonly used in beamline, X-ray, and general scan-based experiments for online monitoring, shutter coordination, and file saving.

registry.name: EPICS Area Detector ROI Statistics
registry.description: EPICS Area Detector ROI Statistics Plugin是由EPICS / Argonne National Laboratory生产的X射线衍射仪，主要功能包括停止、关闭、写入数据、启动、打开、扫描。
